heroSummary:
St. Vrain Valley Schools uses a staggered start for 2026–27. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin August 18; grades 7–8 and 10–12 begin August 19; kindergarten begins August 20; and preschool begins August 24. The last student day is May 27, 2027.

The calendar includes 174 student contact days and seven PLC late-start days. On PLC days, students attend school but start 2.5 hours later than usual.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2025–26
content: The earliest listed student start is five calendar days later, moving from August 13 in 2025–26 to August 18 in 2026–27.
Thanksgiving Break moves from November 24–28 in 2025–26 to November 23–27 in 2026–27.
Winter Break moves from December 22–January 2 to December 21–January 1; students return January 5 after a January 4 non-student contact day.
The last student day is six calendar days later, moving from May 21 in 2026 to May 27 in 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When does St. Vrain Valley Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: SVVSD uses different start dates by grade. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin August 18; grades 7–8 and 10–12 begin August 19; kindergarten begins August 20; and preschool begins August 24.

calendarFaqs.q: When do SVVSD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: January 4, 2027, is a non-student contact day. Students return on Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens on an SVVSD PLC late-start day?
calendarFaqs.a: Students attend school, but classes begin 2.5 hours later than usual. Check with your child’s school for exact bell times and transportation information.

calendarFaqs.q: When is SVVSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 15–19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for SVVSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Graduation dates vary by school and program.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families check school-specific dates?
calendarFaqs.a: Use your child’s school calendar for conferences, bell times, testing, graduation details, and emergency changes. The district calendar page publishes the official English and Spanish academic calendar PDFs.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed against the official SVVSD school-calendar page and the district’s English and Spanish 2026–27 academic calendar PDFs.
sourceReviewDetails: We checked the staggered grade-level start dates, 174 student contact days, seven PLC late-start dates, school breaks, return dates, and the last student day against the official English calendar.
Return dates are derived from the next scheduled student attendance day shown on the official calendar.

PLC dates are attendance days with a 2.5-hour late start. Confirm exact bell times and transportation information with your child’s school; its calendar may also list conferences, testing, and emergency changes.

The Spanish PDF’s important-dates list appears to show March 26 for Life Skills ACE completion, while the English PDF and the Spanish calendar’s May grid show May 26. This page uses May 26; families in the program should confirm the date with SVVSD.
